phrases.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَلَى مَا لَمْ أَزَلْ أَتَصَرَّفُ فِيهِ مِنْ سَلاَمَةِ بَدَنِي،
phrases.english: 1.O God, to You belongs praise for the good health of my body which lets me move about,

phrases.arabic: وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَلَى مَا أَحْدَثْتَ بِيْ مِنْ عِلَّة فِي جَسَـدِي.
phrases.english: 2.and to You belongs praise, for the ailments which You causest to arise in my flesh!

phrases.arabic: فَمَا أَدْرِي يَـا إلهِي، أَيُّ الْحَالَيْنِ أَحَقُّ بِالشُّكْرِ لَكَ،
phrases.english: 3.For I know not, my God, which of the two states deserves more my thanking You

phrases.arabic: وَأَيُّ الْوَقْتَيْنِ أوْلَى بِالْحَمْدِ لَكَ،
phrases.english: 4.and which of the two times is more worthy for my praise of You:

phrases.arabic: أَوَقْتُ الصِّحَةِ الَّتِي هَنَّـأْتَنِي فِيهَا طَيِّبَاتِ رِزْقِكَ،
phrases.english: 5.the time of health, within which You makest me delight in the agreeable things of Your provision,

phrases.arabic: وَنَشَّطْتَنِي بِهَا لابْتِغاءِ مَرْضَاتِكَ وَفَضْلِكَ،
phrases.english: 6.through which You givest me the joy to seek the means to Your good pleasure and bounty,

phrases.arabic: وَقَوَّيْتَنِي مَعَهَا عَلَى مَـا وَفَّقْتَنِي لَهُ مِنْ طَـاعَتِـكَ
phrases.english: 7.and by which You strengthenest me for the acts of obedience which You hast given me success to accomplish;

phrases.arabic: أَمْ وَقْتُ الْعِلَّةِ الَّتِي مَحَّصْتَنِي بِهَا،
phrases.english: 8.or the time of illness through which You puttest me to the test

phrases.arabic: وَالنِّعَمِ الَّتِي أَتْحَفْتَنِي بِهَا
phrases.english: 9.and bestowest upon me favours:

phrases.arabic: تَخْفِيفاً لِمَا ثَقُلَ بِهِ عَلَى ظَهري مِنَ الْخَطِيئاتِ
phrases.english: 10.lightening of the offenses that weigh down my back,

phrases.arabic: وَتَطْهيراً لِمَا انْغَمَسْتُ فيهِ مِنَ السَّيِّئاتِ ،
phrases.english: 11.purification of the evil deeds into which I have plunged,

phrases.arabic: وَتَنْبِيهاً لِتَنَاوُلِ التَّوْبَةِ، وَتَذْكِيراً لِمَحْوِ الْحَوْبَةِ بِقَدِيمِ النِّعْمَةِ،
phrases.english: 12.incitement to reach for repentance, reminder of the erasure of misdeeds through ancient favour;

phrases.arabic: وَفِي خِلاَلِ ذَلِكَ مَا كَتَبَ لِيَ الْكَاتِبَانِ
phrases.english: 13.and, through all that, what the two writers write for me:

phrases.arabic: مِنْ زَكِيِّ الأعْمَالِ، مَا لا قَلْبٌ فَكَّرَ فِيهِ،
phrases.english: 14.blameless acts, which no heart had thought,

phrases.arabic: وَلا لِسَانٌ نَطَقَ بِهِ وَلاَ جَارِحَةٌ تَكَلَّفَتْهُ بَلْ إفْضَالاً مِنْكَ عَلَيَّ،
phrases.english: 15.no tongue had uttered, and no limb had undertaken, rather, as Your bestowal of bounty upon me

phrases.arabic: وَإحْسَاناً مِنْ صَنِيعِـكَ إلَيَّ.
phrases.english: 16.and the beneficence of Your benefaction toward me.

phrases.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّـد وَآلِـهِ
phrases.english: 17.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,

phrases.arabic: وَحَبِّبْ إلَيّ مَـا رَضِيتَ لِي ،
phrases.english: 18.make me love what You hast approved for me,

phrases.arabic: وَيَسِّرْ لِي مَا أَحْلَلْتَ بِيْ،
phrases.english: 19.make easy for me what You hast sent down upon me,

phrases.arabic: وَطَهِّرْنِي مِنْ دَنَسِ مَا أَسْلَفْتُ ،
phrases.english: 20.purify me of the defilement of what I have sent ahead,

phrases.arabic: وَامْحُ عَنِّي شَرَّ مَا قَـدَّمْتُ،
phrases.english: 21.erase the evil of what I have done beforehand,

phrases.arabic: وَأَوْجِدْنِي حَلاَوَةَ الْعَافِيَةِ ، وَأَذِقْنِي بَرْدَ السَّلاَمَةِ
phrases.english: 22.let me find the sweetness of well-being, let me taste the coolness of safety,

phrases.arabic: وَاجْعَلْ مَخْرَجِي عَنْ عِلَّتِي إلَى عَفْوِكَ،
phrases.english: 23.and appoint for me a way out from my illness to Your pardon,

phrases.arabic: وَمُتَحَوَّلِي عَنْ صَرْعَتِي إلَى تَجَاوُزِكَ،
phrases.english: 24.transformation of my infirmity into Your forbearance,

phrases.arabic: وَخَلاصِي مِنْ كَرْبِي إلَى رَوْحِكَ،
phrases.english: 25.escape from my distress to Your refreshment,

phrases.arabic: وَسَلاَمَتِي مِنْ هَذِهِ الشِّدَّةِ إلَى فَرَجِكَ،
phrases.english: 26.and safety from this hardship in Your relief!

phrases.arabic: إنَّكَ الْمُتَفَضِّلُ بِالإِحْسَانِ،
phrases.english: 27.You art gratuitously bountiful in beneficence,

phrases.arabic: الْمُتَطَوِّلُ بِالامْتِنَانِ، الْوَهَّابُ الْكَرِيمُ،
phrases.english: 28.ever gracious in kindness, the Generous, the Giver,

phrases.arabic: ذُو الْجَلاَلِ وَالإكْرَامِ
phrases.english: 29.Possessor of majesty and munificence!
